process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed before running its command: the sandbox wrapper aborted with 'apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied'. This happened for `gh pr view 222`, `git diff --stat fde86d1e..HEAD` and `git rev-parse HEAD` (exit code 1 each time). So the PR diff, file list, intent, closing issues and head SHA could not be read, and the freshness assertion could not run.

No reviewers were spawned. They run in the same sandbox and need `gh pr diff` / `git diff` to scope the change, so they could not have done a grounded review. PR #222 was NOT reviewed; re-run once the runner's sandbox can create user namespaces, or run with the sandbox configured for this runner.
